notes.title: Upcoming Game: Unravel 2
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551150/Unravel_2/]Unravel 2[/url] is an adult game with 2 play modes: a Puzzle Mode and a Story Mode

1) A puzzle mode, with increasing difficulty

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/1b5ce59971799fc562a440844fbbec260e0ab5f1.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/0356208779c8ca2d4ebcaee26518830cb1806b7b.jpg[/img][/url]

2)A story mode where you will be able to follow the story of each event.

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/e3c095b5b8c75c229842e51ab3693a26ed4a519c.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/ea3678eaef38b729d0bf49d09c74d5dbce10d155.jpg[/img][/url]

The game is rich in sexual content and full of sexiness with plans to add even more.
At the moment of launch, we have 6 female characters with their own events and events that link them to the main character and each other. More will be added in the coming weeks.

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/bd4ecc58c7a7650bad521c35dc0580a597a09483.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/2c42f6c5c6ead341f5e314905ffdd95e21623950.jpg[/img][/url]

Take a few moments, or hours, to relax your brain by either solving jigsaw puzzles or by reading the story of each event, surrounded by sexy ladies and relaxing music.

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/fcfbf356c0f7552769497260d3ca98e1135eae62.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065623/a4f28b48025861a99a25b694d023d20818c21126.jpg[/img][/url]

6 different stories, each containing 13 or more different images. The stories were written by The Unicorn and more of his works can be found here:
https://www.literotica.com/stories/memberpage.php?uid=1107934&page=submissions
Rising difficulty: each story start from a 4x4 puzzle working up to a 10x10
Autosave. Once you have completed an image it will be saved as completed.
Image Galery: Once you have completed an image you will be able to see it there.
Story Mode: In story mode you can view and read the stories without completing the puzzles.
Score system: Completing each image gives you points, depending on the difficulty of the image.
HINT system: IF you are stuck, just use the HINT button, this will highlight the correct place for a selected puzzle. This comes at a price, each time you use it, 2 points will be deducted from the points you get for completing that image.
7 chill soundtracks, picked for a nice, relaxing experience. If you like you can always stop the music in the Options Menu.
Translated to Japanese, Chinese, German, and French. Translations were done with machine translating tools.
For the best experience, I recommend playing the game in full-screen mode, as the images were created for 1080p resolutions.

notes.title: Major code update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

In the past 4 days, we have kept refining the code, improved the quality of some translations, and fixed a couple of achievements that were not triggering as they should. 
We have been silent about, no announcements as it was an ongoing effort, but we are now confident we have hammered everything that was reported to us in the past week. 
With this, I would like to thank [b]WEF-Harris, Warkonst, and Griffion[/b] for the effort they have put in identifying and helping us fix bugs. You have been wonderful!

So, bellow is a list of the changes and fixes done: 

- Removed manual memory cleaning in some points, might be that it caused some bugs.
- Fix: Winning hands were being compared wrong
- Fix: Changed a minor thing about the way achievements were being handled.
-Fix: A bug that was causing the game to lock and become unresponsive
- Improved Russian translation.
- Improved Spanish translation.
-- Fix: AI would fold when it should not.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.1.4
notes.notes:
- Added "Super Speed" option.
- Added credits to the main menu.
- Changed the name of the achievement "Winning Streak" to "Frequent Winner".
- Brought the camera a bit closer to the table.
- Made the gallery open faster.
- Added unlocked strip stage indicators for gallery icons.
- Fix: Showdown hands were being compared faultily when equal.
- Fix: Freeze occured when players were being eliminated. We are not sure if it is fixed,
       please report back if you still experience this issue.
- Fix: Fixed a minor bug where the last image of the gallery was being selected on construction.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.1.3
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE v1.1.3[/b]
____________________

- Added the possibility to always fold, even when able to check. (To unlock losing scenes.)
- Added version number to the main menu.
- Fix: Showdown hands had wrong outputs.
- Fix: Wrong winners were chosen.
- Fix: Some buttons were not being able to be clicked when already hovered.
- Fix: Some stats didn't work correctly and did not trigger achievements.
       We tried to fix the issue but are not sure if it is fixed entirely, will watch the leaderboards.
- Fix: Some players experienced crashes when playing the final story match. We could not replicate this crash, we made the game overall more crash-resistant.  Please report back if you are still experiencing this issue.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

With your help, we have identified and fixed a couple of bugs and we also took your feedback and added a Hide UI key --> [u][b]H[/b][/u] and some other stuff. 
We would like to thank those of you who have taken the time and made the effort of reporting these bugs and give us the feedback that leads to making this game a better one. 

Full Changelog: 

- Added losing sequences to the gallery
- Added strip sequences to the gallery
- Added "Hide UI" key --> [u][b]Press H to hide/unhide[/b][/u]
- Added "Mute Win Sound" option
- Added a new sound for Royal Flush
- Did some small AI adjustments, Casual should fold a bit less often
- Fix: Showdown hands were being compared faultily
- Fix: Aiko + Destiny lose sequence didn't show up
- Fix: Sequence image was clickable in lose sequences and when opening
